projects.name: Books|2|Shelf
projects.subtitle: A Digital Bookshelf | With Google Books API
projects.description: Live search against the Google Books API, and an account to keep what you find.
projects.challenge: Build a seamless single-page application that handles real-time book searches, user authentication, and persistent data storage while maintaining excellent performance.
projects.solution: Developed using React and Vite for fast build times, integrated Firebase for backend services including Auth and Firestore database, connected Google Books API for extensive book data, and styled with Tailwind CSS for a modern, responsive design.
impact: Real-time book search with Google Books API integration
Secure user authentication with Firebase Auth
Cloud-based data storage with Firestore database
Fully responsive across all devices
highlights: Single Page Application (SPA) architecture
Google Books API integration for book data
Firebase Authentication & Firestore database
Real-time search functionality
Deployed on Vercel with continuous integration

Skills & projects showcase integration

projects.name: Bestsellers
projects.subtitle: Modern Full-Stack E-commerce Bookstore
projects.description: A complete online bookstore on the Next.js App Router — real payments, real accounts, real admin. Not a demo shop.
projects.challenge: Build an e-commerce bookstore that goes beyond a simple demo shop, with real payments, robust auth, reviews, and an admin back office — while keeping performance, accessibility, and DX high.
projects.solution: Implemented a full-stack Next.js 15 App Router app with TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL. Integrated Stripe for payments and webhooks, NextAuth for auth, and Resend for transactional email. Added an admin dashboard for inventory, orders, coupons, and reports.
impact: Real payments and refunds powered by Stripe with webhooks
Rich storefront with search, filters, categories, reviews, and recently viewed tracking
Full auth system with email/password, OAuth, password reset, and profile management
Admin dashboard for books, users, orders, coupons, and exportable reports
Optimized for performance, mobile responsiveness, and accessibility
highlights: Fully featured bookstore with search, filters, categories, author pages, reviews, and recently viewed
Cart, checkout, and secure Stripe integration with webhooks for order status and refunds
Wishlist with sharing links, newsletter sign-up, and email-backed contact form
Admin dashboard for books, users, orders, coupons, and exportable reports
Production deployment on Vercel with managed Postgres and performance-focused UX

projects.name: arefsaboor.com
projects.subtitle: A Bilingual Writing Site | English & Persian
projects.description: A personal publication with its own editor, reader notes and email pipeline — written in two languages, in both reading directions.
projects.challenge: Publish essays in English and Persian from one codebase, without a third-party CMS or engagement service. That means two reading directions in the same design system, a writing surface I actually want to use, and comments, notes and email that stay under my own control.
projects.solution: Built on the Next.js App Router with TypeScript and Tailwind, backed by PostgreSQL. Persian lives in its own route tree with right-to-left typography rather than a translation layer. Reader engagement is written through server actions and batched into dedicated flush endpoints, and a private dashboard handles posts, comments and reader notes.
impact: One codebase serving English and Persian, each with its own typography
Self-hosted commenting, notes and reactions with no third-party embed
Double opt-in email with verification and one-click unsubscribe
Articles readable as a paginated book and exportable to PDF
highlights: Fully bilingual: a complete Persian route tree beside the English one, with right-to-left typography
Reader notes, comments, claps and likes, batched through dedicated flush endpoints
Email pipeline with address verification, notifications and one-click unsubscribe
A private writing dashboard for posts, comments and reader notes
Articles render as a paginated flip-book and export to PDF
